card.text: Young Sun-like star 21 parsecs away whose magnetic field was mapped in December 2017.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: We present five new ZDI maps of young, solar-type stars from December 2017.

introduction.text: BE Ceti is a young star like the Sun that turns once every 7.7 days. Its magnetic field, mapped in 2017, shows no sign of having flipped since 2013.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: No signs of polarity reversals are detected.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field.title: Radial field, Dec 2017
radial-field.summary: Where the magnetic field points out of the star or into it, mapped from how it polarises starlight.

meridional-field.title: Meridional field, Dec 2017
meridional-field.summary: The part of the magnetic field running north or south along the surface.

azimuthal-field.title: Azimuthal field, Dec 2017
azimuthal-field.summary: The part of the magnetic field running around the spin axis.

corona-dec-2017.title: Derived corona, Dec 2017
corona-dec-2017.summary: Derived here from the field mapped in Dec 2017. Brightness follows density at each distance.
